summary: Several regression tests were added to make media playback from Blobs and cached data more reliable: tests ensure seeking and decoding work when a video is read from CacheStorage or rebuilt from an ArrayBuffer, and MP4 edit-list preroll behavior was fixed so preroll frames aren’t presented before playback starts. These tests protect cached and blob-based playback scenarios often used by service workers and web apps, improving reliability for offline and progressive-loading experiences.
